examples.ko: 우리 회사에서는 새 직원을 한 달 동안 교육해요.
examples.en: At our company we train new employees for a month.
My parents raised me strictly.
A school is a place that educates students.
I'm thinking about how to educate my child.
The hospital is training its nurses.

examples.ko: 아이들에게 안전 규칙을 교육하면 사고가 줄어요.
examples.en: If you teach children safety rules, accidents go down.

explain: 일상에서는 '가르치다'를 쓰고, '교육하다'는 학교, 회사, 기관이 체계적으로 할 때 어울려요. '한국어를 가르쳐요'는 자연스럽지만 '한국어를 교육해요'는 딱딱하게 들려요. 배우는 쪽은 '교육을 받다'라고 해요.

phrases.en: I received safety training at my company.
phrases.nuance_ko: 배우는 쪽이 주어일 때는 '교육을 받다'라고 해요.
phrases.nuance_en: When the learner is the subject, say 교육을 받다.

phrases.en: A school is a place that educates children.
phrases.nuance_ko: 뒤에 명사를 붙여서 '교육하는 곳/사람'처럼 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Put a noun after it, as in 'a place/person that educates'.

phrases.en: This academy teaches children.
phrases.nuance_ko: 기관이 계속 하고 있는 일을 말할 때 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits an institution describing what it does on an ongoing basis.

explain_en: In daily life use '가르치다'; '교육하다' suits schools, companies, or institutions teaching in a structured way. '한국어를 가르쳐요' sounds natural, but '한국어를 교육해요' sounds stiff. The learner's side is '교육을 받다' (receive education).

p.n: 교육시키다 stresses making or arranging for the student to be trained.

examples.en: I bought a Korean workbook at the bookstore.
The explanations in this workbook are easy.
The workbook is thick, so I do a little every day.

examples.ko: 수학 문제집에 답이 틀린 곳이 있어요.
examples.en: There is a wrong answer in the math workbook.

examples.ko: 방학 때 문제집도 풀고 책도 읽었어요.
examples.en: During vacation I did workbooks and read books too.
My younger sibling prepares for the test with a workbook.

explain: '문제집을 풀다'처럼 '풀다'와 같이 써요. 교과서처럼 설명을 배우는 책이 아니라 연습 문제가 중심인 책이에요. 시험에 나왔던 문제를 모은 책은 '기출 문제집'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I solve one page of the workbook every day.
phrases.nuance_ko: 문제집과 가장 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: The most common verb pairing for 문제집.

phrases.example: 시험 전에 기출 문제집을 풀어 봤어요.
phrases.en: I tried a past-exam workbook before the test.
phrases.nuance_ko: 예전 시험 문제를 모은 책을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: A book collecting questions from past exams.

phrases.en: I went to the bookstore and bought a workbook.
phrases.nuance_ko: 공부 준비를 할 때 쓰는 가장 쉬운 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A simple phrase for getting ready to study.

explain_en: It goes with the verb '풀다': '문제집을 풀다' (work through a workbook). Unlike a textbook, it is mostly practice problems. A book of past exam questions is a '기출 문제집'.

examples.ko: 저는 오전반이라서 아침 아홉 시에 시작해요.
examples.en: I'm in the morning class, so I start at nine a.m.
The morning class ends at twelve.

examples.ko: 오전반과 오후반 중에 어느 반이 좋아요?
examples.en: Which do you prefer, the morning class or the afternoon class?
I want to move to the morning class. Is there a spot?

examples.ko: 동생은 오전반에 다녀서 점심 전에 와요.
examples.en: My younger sibling goes to the morning class, so he comes home before lunch.

examples.ko: 이번 학기에는 오전반 학생이 더 많아요.
examples.en: This semester, there are more students in the morning class.

explain: 학원, 학교, 어린이집에서 시간대로 나눈 반을 말해요. 짝이 되는 말은 '오후반'이고, '저녁반', '주말반'도 같은 방식으로 말해요.

phrases.en: The morning class starts at nine.
phrases.nuance_ko: 반의 이름 뒤에 '수업'을 붙여 시간대를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adds 'class' after the group name to talk about its time slot.

phrases.en: I'm in the morning class this semester.
phrases.nuance_ko: 내가 어느 반인지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say which class you belong to.

phrases.en: I get up early, so I signed up for the morning class.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학원에 등록할 때 시간대를 고르는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when choosing a time slot at registration.
phrases.en_equiv: to sign up for the morning class

explain_en: It names a class group by time of day at an academy, school or daycare. Its counterpart is '오후반', and '저녁반' and '주말반' are formed the same way.

examples.en: There are one hundred new students this year in total.
The new students are gathered in the auditorium.
The seniors welcomed the new students.
They hand out new textbooks to the entering students.
I was also an entering student at this school last year.
The representative of the new students greeted everyone at the front.

explain: 비슷한 말로 '신입생'이 있어요. 짝이 되는 말은 학교를 마친 '졸업생'이에요.

phrases.en: There are one hundred new students this year.
phrases.nuance_ko: '입학생'과 거의 같은 뜻이고, 더 자주 들어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Almost the same meaning as 입학생, and heard more often.

phrases.en: The representative of the new students gave a greeting in the hall.
phrases.nuance_ko: 입학식에서 대표로 말하는 학생을 가리켜요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers to the student who speaks on behalf of the group at the entrance ceremony.

phrases.en: The new students and graduates took a photo together.
phrases.nuance_ko: 짝이 되는 말 '졸업생'과 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used together with its paired word 졸업생.

explain_en: A similar word is 신입생. The counterpart is 졸업생, a student who has finished school.

en: to major in; to specialize in

examples.en: I major in business at university.
My older sister majored in music at university.
What do you want to major in at university?
Many students major in Korean.
What work can you do if you major in art?
I want to work in the field I majored in.

explain: '공부하다'는 무엇이든 배울 때 쓰지만 '전공하다'는 대학에서 중심으로 배우는 한 분야에만 써요. 사람을 만나면 '전공이 뭐예요?'라고 자주 물어요. 전공을 두 개 하면 '복수 전공'이라고 해요.

phrases.en: I ask a friend I just met, "What is your major?"
phrases.nuance_ko: 사람을 처음 만났을 때 자주 하는 질문이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common question when you first meet someone.

phrases.en: I majored in art at university.
phrases.nuance_ko: 과거형으로, 이미 대학에서 배운 분야를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: The past form, used for a field you studied at university.

phrases.en: I am doing a double major.
phrases.nuance_ko: 전공을 두 개 할 때 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when someone studies two majors.

explain_en: '공부하다' works for studying anything, but 전공하다 is only for the one main field you study at university. When meeting people, Koreans often ask '전공이 뭐예요?' (what's your major?). Having two majors is '복수 전공'.

examples.en: My older sister studied nursing at a junior college.

examples.ko: 전문대는 보통 이 년이나 삼 년 만에 졸업해요.
examples.en: You usually graduate from a junior college in two or three years.
I graduated from junior college and went straight into a company.
There is one junior college in our neighborhood.

examples.ko: 제 동생은 전문대 입학 시험을 준비하고 있어요.
examples.en: My younger brother is preparing for a junior college entrance exam.

examples.ko: 전문대와 대학교 중에서 어디로 갈지 고민이에요.
examples.en: I'm torn between a junior college and a university.

explain: 4년제 '대학교'와 짝으로 자주 말하고, 보통 과정이 더 짧고 직업 기술을 배우는 쪽이에요. 정식 이름은 '전문대학'이지만 말할 때는 대부분 '전문대'라고 해요.

phrases.en: I learned cooking at a junior college.
phrases.nuance_ko: '전문대'의 정식 이름이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: This is the formal name for '전문대'.

phrases.en: I graduated from a junior college and got a job right away.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교를 마쳤다고 말할 때 '졸업하다'를 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use '졸업하다' to say you finished school.
phrases.en_equiv: to graduate from a junior college

phrases.en: My younger sibling attends a junior college.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 학교에 다니고 있을 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Use it when someone is currently enrolled.

explain_en: It is often paired with the four-year '대학교', and its programs are usually shorter and focused on job skills. The formal name is '전문대학', but in speech people mostly say '전문대'.

examples.en: Our school's student council is preparing the festival.

examples.ko: 학생회는 한 달에 한 번 회의를 해요.
examples.en: The student council has a meeting once a month.
My friend is leading the student council this year.
I will join the student council next year too.
A new president of the student council was elected.
The student council and the teachers discussed it together.

explain: 중고등학교에서는 '학생회', 대학교에서는 '총학생회'를 많이 써요. 반 안의 일은 '반장'이 맡고, 학교 전체를 대표하는 사람은 '학생회장'이에요.

phrases.en: Our school's student council president is a third-year student.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학교 전체를 대표하는 사람을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The person who represents the whole school.

phrases.en: The student council meeting is at lunchtime.
phrases.nuance_ko: 학생회 사람들이 모여 하는 회의예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A meeting held by the student council members.

phrases.en: Our university's student union is holding an event.
phrases.nuance_ko: 대학교 전체의 학생회를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The student council of a whole university.

explain_en: Middle and high schools say '학생회', and universities often say '총학생회'. Matters inside a class are handled by the '반장' (class president), while the head of the whole school is the '학생회장'.
